[[File:Fuel_Tanker_SWA.png|thumb|right|250px|A GR-75 medium transport refueling a Nebulon-B assault frigate]]
'''Refueling tankers''' were [[Tanker/Legends|tanker]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]] used by various [[Navy/Legends|navies]] to refuel other vessels in space. One notable refueling tanker was the [[Bastion (tanker)|''Bastion'']], used by [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]'s [[Zsinj's Empire|Imperial forces]].<ref name="IF">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref> Another example was the [[Golan Ribbon tanker/Legends|Golan Ribbon tanker]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="IH:ACG">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref> The [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] also functions as a refueling tanker at times.<ref name="FFGweb-Star Wars™: Armada Fleet Commander Contest">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2016/6/27/star-wars-armada-fleet-commander-contest|text=Star Wars™: Armada Fleet Commander Contest}}</ref>
